senses.gloss: f., constr. (טְלַם) טוּלְמת [panis aqueus ac mollis, P. Sm. 1477] cake, loaf.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 31:17">Targ. Job. XXXI, 17</cite> <he>ט׳ דלחמי</he> Ms. (ed. only <he>טולמי</he>); a. e.—

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 3:2">Targ. Esth. III, 2</cite> <he>ט׳ דלחם</he> ed. Lag.; Yalk. ib. 105ᵇ <he>ט׳ דנהמא</he>.—[Y. Snh. II, 20ᶜ bot. <he>מנהם טלמא</he>, v. <cite ref="I00514"><he>טַלְמָיָא</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>טוּלְמִין</he>, <he>טוּלְמֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 14:3">Targ. I Kings XIV, 3</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Megillah 15b">Meg. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>בטולמי דנהמא</he> Ms. M. 2 (ed. only <he>בטַלְמֵי</he>) for loaves of bread. [Ar. s. v. <cite ref="G00392"><he>זיף</he></cite> quotes, in Hebr. diction, (play on <cite ref="Joshua 15:24">Josh. XV, 24</cite>) <he>כל המוזיף טולמיין וכ׳</he> ed. Koh. (oth. ed. <he>טולמין</he>, <he>טולמון</he>) he who lends bread to the poor, will be raised.]
